line_content: The training pipeline utilizes a Teacher-Student Distillation approach where the student model mimics the teacher.
context: Summary: The project aims to create a self-aware AI. The training pipeline utilizes a Teacher-Student Distillation approach where the student model mimics the teacher. This is inconsistent with spec assumptions.

line_content: Data preparation involves generating Pre-computed Teacher Labels for the training set.
context: Data Preparation: Data preparation involves generating Pre-computed Teacher Labels for the training set. These labels are derived from a larger external model.

line_content: The loss function minimizes the distance to external truth signals.
context: Loss Function: The loss function minimizes the distance to external truth signals. This contradicts the self-referential nature of the spec.
